description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'JpaUtils' that provides methods for working with JPA queries in the OpenMRS project. The main method 'getSingleResultOrNull' executes a JPA query to retrieve a single result, returning null if none is found, and throwing an exception if multiple results are found.

classes.name: JpaUtils
classes.description: A utility class for handling JPA query results in the OpenMRS project.

methods.name: getSingleResultOrNull
methods.description: Executes a JPA query to retrieve a single result, returning null when no result is found, or throwing an exception if multiple results exist.
